channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Dragonhold
item.description: Dragonhold is a dragon-riding extraction ARPG. Dive into missions, fight on dragonback and on foot, loot powerful gear, then extract (at any time) back to your island to grow your town and rebuild Dragonhold castle. Playable solo or in online co-op.

item.title: Fallout 2: A Post Nuclear Role Playing Game
item.description: Fallout® 2 is the sequel to the critically acclaimed game that took RPG'ing out of the dungeons and into a dynamic, apocalyptic retro-future. It's been 80 long years since your ancestors trod across the wastelands.

item.title: Fallout 3
item.description: Vault-Tec engineers have worked around the clock on an interactive reproduction of Wasteland life for you to enjoy from the comfort of your own vault. Included is an expansive world, unique combat, shockingly realistic visuals, tons of player choice, and an incredible cast of dynamic characters.

item.title: Fallout: A Post Nuclear Role Playing Game
item.description: You've just unearthed the classic post-apocalyptic role-playing game that revitalized the entire CRPG genre. The Fallout® SPECIAL system allows drastically different types of characters, meaningful decisions and development that puts you in complete control. Explore the devastated ruins of a golden age civilization.

item.title: Renowned Explorers: International Society
item.description: In this strategic rogue-like you become a famous expedition leader in the 19th century. You form your own crew with the skills and personality to discover legendary treasures, while exploring randomized locations and stories on every new adventure.

item.title: Vampire Hunters
item.description: To hunt vampires, you'll need guns. Lots of guns. Mow down hordes of undead creatures by stacking your guns into absurd, over-the-top builds. Unleash your firepower and survive the mayhem in this Roguelite Survivors FPS.

item.title: VConnect
item.description: VConnect is a stream overlay used to create on screen effects of all kind upon raids, subs, follows and more. With a Set-Up Wizard for less experienced users and an extensive Node System for power users, it's perfect to bring your ideas to life without the need to know coding!

item.title: FIRE STATE
item.description: Experience lifelike visuals and fluid controls from a realistic bodycam-style perspective in the world's first shooter with playable 3DGS environments. Compete in classic PVP, join a co-op campaign, or face horror levels.

item.title: RAGE
item.description: Powered by id’s revolutionary id Tech® 5 technology, RAGE is an intense first-person shooter with breakneck vehicle combat, an expansive world to explore, and jaw-dropping graphics!

item.title: Alice and the Devil's Prison
item.description: Escape adventure game. During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons. Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely?

item.title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect
item.description: Make friends or frenemies! Be a savvy schemer in this hybrid RPG party game!

item.title: DOOM 64
item.description: Play the enhanced version of the original game released on the Nintendo 64 in 1997. Years have passed since you stopped Hell’s invasion of Earth. Quarantined for humanity’s safety, the UAC research facilities on Mars were abandoned and forgotten...until now.

item.title: Lucid Blocks
item.description: Explore, build, and survive in a cryptic expanse oozing with dreamlike oddities and esoteric critters.

item.title: RAGE 2
item.description: RAGE 2 brings together two studio powerhouses – Avalanche Studios, masters of open world insanity, and id Software, creators of the first-person shooter – to deliver a carnival of carnage where you can go anywhere, shoot anything, and explode everything.

item.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
item.description: Are you ready, kids? The cult classic is back, faithfully remade in spongetastic splendor! Play as SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy and show the evil Plankton that crime pays even less than Mr. Krabs.

item.title: Titan Quest Anniversary Edition
item.description: For its 10 year anniversary, Titan Quest will shine in new splendour. This Anniversary Edition combines both Titan Quest and Titan Quest Immortal Throne in one game, and has been given a massive overhaul for the ultimate ARPG experience.

item.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Pandora Tomorrow
item.description: Infiltrate secure locations across the globe in this stealth-action thriller. Uncover a global conspiracy and stop a deadly bio-terror attack in the second game of the award-winning Splinter Cell series.

item.title: Warfare Legacy Collection
item.description: Warfare 1917 and 1944 return, fully remastered with enhanced visuals, full-screen support, and custom battles. Warfare Legacy Collection also Includes the Battle of the Bulge, a brand-new campaign set during WWII’s final offensive with all-new missions, snowy maps, and intense front-line action.

item.title: DragonSword : Awakening - Costume : Moonlight on the Night Sea
item.description: Purchasing this content lets you obtain "Moonlight on the Night Sea" which adorns Cerese's outfit, and "Star upon the Waves" which adorns the weapon's appearance.

item.title: Expeditions: Samurai
item.description: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

item.title: Gothic 1 Remake
item.description: The Legend is Back - Return to the Valley of the Mines in this faithful remake of the genre-defining classic RPG. Explore a hand-crafted, organic open world that reacts dynamically to your actions in a gritty, unrestricted experience like no other.

item.title: GRAIN ROT
item.description: A horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.

item.title: Muse Dash
item.description: Paradise of parkour & rhythm game ★★★ — Muse Dash!!

item.title: Redfall
item.description: The town of Redfall is under siege by a legion of vampires who have cut the island off from the outside world. Trapped with a handful of survivors, slay alone or squad up in open-world FPS action.

item.title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon® Wildlands - Fallen Ghosts
item.description: Hunted Down by Ex-disgraced Special Forces that created their own army, your squad will have to fight harder than ever to complete your mission. - Fight a new powerful enemy, learn new skills and unlock exclusive weapons in order to complete your mission.

item.title: Moonlighter
item.description: Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

item.title: Breathedge
item.description: Survive in outer space! Together with your immortal chicken, discover the truth behind your sudden spaceship crash. Craft tools, pilot vehicles, and even control space stations to survive and explore the wreckage.
